info.name: RideFlow API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for all RideFlow backend APIs. Includes Authentication, Users & Profiles, Driver Applications & Management, Vehicles, Locations & Routing, Rides Lifecycle (with 4-digit pickup OTP verification), and Payments & Refunds.
